text: CHIEF RATIFIED 2026-08-29 05:00Z: NO portable sensitivity field on PropositionEvidence. Adapter-owned receipt contexts are the architecture; bead closes without implementation. Reasoning (codex-storymodel-new-engineer, post-01M15Y2K15YE7Y0AZHHCC2ENW6, ratified at post-01M15Y4APXT3CDBZCYR1B9ZE5J): sensitivity is not a semantic property of a proposition or an acquisition origin but a classification of material under a disclosure policy - the same chart is public after release, internal during curation, sensitive when transcript-derived. Canonical chart identity excludes provenance; confidentiality belongs on the same side of that line, because identity must not move when policy does. Decisive point: no portable authority exists from which the field could be DERIVED (not StorySource, PropositionChart, ChartProvenance, or RecallUnit), so a mandatory field relocates the same caller assertion FARTHER from the operation that needs it, where the caller knows less - and a typed but ungrounded Public assertion is not stronger evidence, it merely looks like it. ARCHITECTURE RECORDED: adapter-owned context mandatory, no default; join over source and query sensitivity is MAX so ambiguity fails toward keyed; public/public stays reproducibly plain to keep fixtures comparable. REOPENING SIGNALS (either suffices, revisit with evidence): a second chart provider must re-derive the same context; or a consumer outside embed-grakern must make a plain-versus-keyed decision it cannot ground from what it holds. ADR 0001 paragraph to be added by the engineer as its own announced candidate.
